trans-unit.note: Screen-reader announcement suffix when a q8a card is placed with no card displaced, card's alt text is prepended.

trans-unit.source: הוחזר לרשימת הרעיונות.
trans-unit.note: Screen-reader announcement suffix when a q8a card is returned to the source tray, card's alt text is prepended.

trans-unit.source: הועבר למקום אחר בספר החוקים.
trans-unit.note: Screen-reader announcement suffix when a placed q8a card is moved to another slot, card's alt text is prepended.

trans-unit.source: נבחר. בחרו מקום אחר בספר כדי להעביר אליו, או לחצו כאן שוב כדי להחזיר אותו לרשימה.
trans-unit.note: Screen-reader announcement suffix after picking up an already-placed q8a card, card's alt text is prepended.
